Submit.heading: Submit a Product

authRequired.after: as a contributor to submit a product.

Submit.description: Suggest an open-source alternative for inclusion in our directory. Submissions are reviewed by our team before publishing.

guidelines.heading: Submission Guidelines
guidelines.intro: Please review these requirements before submitting. Submissions that don't meet the criteria will be flagged or rejected during review.

rule1.title: 1. Must be open-source
rule1.description: The project must have a publicly accessible repository with a recognized open-source license (MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL, etc.).

rule2.title: 2. Must be a real, functional project
rule2.description: The project should have meaningful functionality, not be a boilerplate, starter template, or empty repository.

rule3.title: 3. Must have an active repository
rule3.description: The repository should have recent commit activity, open issues, or community engagement showing it is actively developed or maintained.

rule4.title: 4. Unique value proposition
rule4.description: The project should offer a clear alternative to an existing proprietary or popular tool. Duplicate submissions may be merged or declined.

rule5.title: 5. Accurate metadata
rule5.description: Provide correct project name, description, repository URL, and categories. Inaccurate or misleading submissions will be rejected.

FAQ.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Forklane.

whatIsForklane.question: What is Forklane?
whatIsForklane.answer: Forklane is an open-source software discovery platform that helps developers find alternatives to proprietary tools. Every listing is backed by live GitHub and npm data with transparent confidence scores.

howDecideTools.question: How are migration confidence scores calculated?
howDecideTools.answer: We analyze repository activity, community size, documentation quality, deployment options, and ecosystem compatibility to generate a confidence score for each alternative.

areToolsFree.question: Can I submit my own project?
areToolsFree.answer: Yes! Sign up as a contributor and submit your open-source project. Our team reviews submissions before publishing to ensure quality and accuracy.

howCurrent.question: How do I report an issue with a listing?
howCurrent.answer: Use the report button on any product page to flag broken links, wrong categories, or outdated information. Our moderation team reviews reports promptly.

howToList.question: Can I claim ownership of a product listing?
howToList.answer: Yes. If you maintain or own a listed project, you can verify ownership via DNS TXT record or GitHub organization membership to display a verified badge.

findReplacement.question: Is Forklane free to use?
findReplacement.answer: Yes. Forklane is completely free and open-source. We don't track users or sell data. Our goal is to make open-source discovery accessible to everyone.
